embed.title: !broadcast (admin)
embed.description: Send a message from `config/broadcast.json` to registered users chosen by location or area — for maintenance notices, announcements or event warnings.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}broadcast [<lat>,<lon> d<metres>] [@<area> …] [test] <message id>`

The message id is the `id` of an entry in `config/broadcast.json` (see `examples/broadcast.json`). An entry can set `"platform": "discord"` or `"telegram"`, or leave it out to serve both. If any recipient's platform has no entry, nothing is sent.

Only enabled users receive it — never channels, groups or webhooks.

fields.name: Choose the audience
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}broadcast 51.5,-0.12 d5000 donate` — users whose location is within 5000 m
`{{prefix}}broadcast @london @paris donate` — users who have either area selected

Write the coordinates without a space after the comma, before the message id. A location and areas can be combined: a user matching either gets the message. At least one is required. Areas are matched against the areas of each user's active profile; write spaces in area names as underscores (`@north_london`).

fields.name: Test
fields.value: `{{prefix}}broadcast test donate` — send the message only to yourself.

fields.name: Care
fields.value: A broadcast counts against each recipient's alert limit. The reply lists everyone it was sent to; delivery to a large audience takes a while because messages are paced to the platform's rate limits.
